title: Morning Brief, Fri 20 Nov 2026: Cyclone Akvan, weakened to a cyclonic storm (IMD National Bulletin 37, 07:30 IST), crossing the north Andhra-south Odisha coast near Gopalpur this forenoon at 70-80 kmph gusting 90, landfall due complete by ~11 am; Odisha moved nearly 3 lakh people; ECoR ~45 trains cancelled Thu-Sat, SER at least 28 on Fri (lead); EPFO board (CBT, 19 Nov) approves monthly/quarterly/half-yearly PF payouts for retirees, final-withdrawal wait 12 to 2 months, minimum balance 25% to 10%, effective on Labour Ministry notification; Malaysia: Indians need a visa from 1 Jan 2027, MyVISA applications from 1 Dec 2026 (Immigration Department notice 17 Nov); Madhya Pradesh Cabinet (18 Nov) scraps 25-year-old two-child rule for government jobs; NZ 368 all out v India, 1st Test Wellington Day 2 (Nicholls 175*, Phillips 118, Bumrah 4 wkts).
headline: Weakened Cyclone Akvan Crossing Odisha Coast; Nearly 3 Lakh Evacuated

image.licence: Public domain (NASA EOSDIS GIBS / Worldview imagery, US government work)
image.author: NASA Worldview / EOSDIS GIBS, MODIS on the Terra satellite, morning pass of 19 Nov 2026
image.subject: Cyclone Akvan's spiral cloud mass over the west-central Bay of Bengal pressing on the north Andhra Pradesh / south Odisha coast, 19 Nov 2026 (Terra morning pass); bbox 11.4-21.4N, 79.9-87.9E. New still: earlier Akvan covers used 16 Nov Terra, 18 Nov Terra and 18 Nov Aqua passes. Shows Akvan the day before landfall, not the landfall itself.

fact_sources.fact: Akvan weakened from a severe cyclonic storm to a cyclonic storm; IMD National Bulletin No. 37 (issued 07:30 IST 20 Nov, position at 05:30 IST): crossing north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coasts close to Gopalpur by forenoon 20 Nov, 70-80 kmph gusting to 90; forecast deep depression by 17:30 IST
Landfall process has begun near Gopalpur (IMD); IMD Bhubaneswar expects it complete between 10 and 11 am (OdishaTV); HT: process to continue for next three hours (07:47 IST update)
Akvan expected to weaken rapidly after landfall (IMD forecast table; IMD DG Mohapatra)
Odisha moved nearly 3 lakh people: 2,98,676 to 2,523 relief camps by Thursday evening (SRC Rajesh P Patil, PTI); 'over 3 lakh' evacuated (ANI)

East Coast Railway has cancelled about 45 trains over Thu-Sat (CPRO Deepak Rout, HT); 'about 39-45 trains between 19 and 21 Nov' (Odisha Bytes); earlier ECoR figure 41 cancelled, 29 rescheduled (The Hindu, HT)
South Eastern Railway cancelled at least 28 express trains on Friday, mostly to or through Puri

EPFO's Central Board of Trustees (240th meeting, Thu 19 Nov, chaired by Labour Minister Mandaviya) approved a voluntary Systematic Withdrawal Plan: monthly, quarterly or half-yearly PF instalments for retiring members, remainder keeps earning; ~6.32 lakh members over 55 with more than Rs 5 lakh are the initial primary beneficiaries
Board cut the waiting period for (final) withdrawal from 12 months to two months and the minimum balance from 25% to 10% of contributions

Not yet in force: TOI says the EPF Scheme amendments will be notified after the ministry's approval; the Labour Ministry release (DT Next) calls it the 'proposed SWP framework'; HT says the board 'approved' it

Malaysia's Immigration Department (JIM) notice of 17 Nov: visa exemption for Indians ends; from 1 Jan 2027 Indians need a valid visa before arrival; MyVISA applications from 1 Dec 2026; fees non-refundable; 30-day visa-free entry since Dec 2023; Malaysian High Commission told TOI the period 'tentatively' ends 31 Dec 2026

Madhya Pradesh Cabinet (special meeting, Gandhi Sagar, Wed 18 Nov) scrapped the 25-year-old (2001, Congress government) two-child rule: more than two children barred state government jobs; serving employees faced action/dismissal over a third child; government cites falling birth/fertility rates; employees already dismissed won't have cases reopened

India v New Zealand, 1st Test, Wellington, Day 2 (20 Nov): NZ all out 368 in 121 overs; Henry Nicholls 175 not out; Glenn Phillips 118; Bumrah 4 wickets, Akash Deep 3; NZ were 70/5 on Day 1; India began their reply
